title: Design System: Riverside Tenis (Polvo de Ladrillo)

display.purpose: Headings, wordmark, dates and times only — echo of the club's condensed wordmark. Loaded via next/font as --font-display; applied to h1-h4.

body.purpose: All UI, body and control text. Neutral system voice doing the work.

label.purpose: Form labels and table heads: 12px, 600, uppercase, 0.025em tracking, muted #6E6357.

shadows.name: resting-ficha
shadows.purpose: Default ambient shadow on every resting ficha, table container and form card.

shadows.name: raised
shadows.purpose: Hover on cards; the day strip and day court panel.

shadows.name: lit
shadows.purpose: Only the in-progress class on the day court, combined with ring-2 ring-white. The single lit element.

motion.name: day-in
motion.purpose: The one motion moment: redrawing the day court on day change. Guarded by prefers-reduced-motion: reduce → animation: none.

motion.name: state-transition
motion.purpose: Hover, focus and disabled feedback on buttons, cards, links and nav items.

components.name: Primary Button
components.description: The single feltro action of a screen: sign in, enroll, create.
components.css: .ds-btn-primary { background: #D9E24F; color: #241C15; font-family: ui-sans-serif, system-ui, -apple-system, 'Segoe UI', Roboto, 'Helvetica Neue', Arial, sans-serif; font-size: 16px; font-weight: 600; padding: 8px 16px; border: 1px solid #C3CC3F; border-radius: 12px; cursor: pointer; transition: filter 150ms, opacity 150ms; } .ds-btn-primary:hover { filter: brightness(0.95); } .ds-btn-primary:active { filter: brightness(0.9); } .ds-btn-primary:disabled { opacity: 0.5; cursor: default; } .ds-btn-primary:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #B65434; outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Secondary Button
components.description: Quiet companion action: white ficha with the warm keyline.
components.css: .ds-btn-secondary { background: #FFFFFF; color: #241C15; font-family: ui-sans-serif, system-ui, -apple-system, 'Segoe UI', Roboto, 'Helvetica Neue', Arial, sans-serif; font-size: 16px; padding: 8px 16px; border: 1px solid #E4DBCB; border-radius: 12px; cursor: pointer; transition: background 150ms; } .ds-btn-secondary:hover { background: #F7F3EA; } .ds-btn-secondary:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #B65434; outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Text Field
components.description: White field with warm stroke; polvo ring and caret on focus.
components.css: .ds-field { display: block; font-family: ui-sans-serif, system-ui, -apple-system, 'Segoe UI', Roboto, 'Helvetica Neue', Arial, sans-serif; } .ds-field-label { display: block; font-size: 12px; font-weight: 600; letter-spacing: 0.025em; text-transform: uppercase; color: #6E6357; margin-bottom: 4px; } .ds-input { width: 100%; box-sizing: border-box; background: #FFFFFF; color: #241C15; font-size: 16px; padding: 8px 12px; border: 1px solid #E4DBCB; border-radius: 12px; caret-color: #B65434; transition: border-color 150ms, box-shadow 150ms; } .ds-input:hover { border-color: #cdc2ae; } .ds-input:focus { outline: none; border-color: #B65434; box-shadow: 0 0 0 2px rgba(182, 84, 52, 0.4); } .ds-input:disabled { background: #F1EFEA; color: #6E6357; }

components.name: Chip
components.description: Pill status marker: neutral, cupo-full red, with-space green, and the polvo state marker (Ahora/Hoy).
components.html: Fija 4/4 Lleno 2/4 Ahora
components.css: .ds-chip { display: inline-block; padding: 2px 8px; border-radius: 9999px; font-family: ui-sans-serif, system-ui, -apple-system, 'Segoe UI', Roboto, 'Helvetica Neue', Arial, sans-serif; font-size: 12px; font-weight: 600; line-height: 1.4; white-space: nowrap; } .ds-chip--neutral { background: #F7F3EA; color: #6E6357; border: 1px solid #E4DBCB; } .ds-chip--full { background: #FBECEA; color: #8F1E18; } .ds-chip--space { background: #EAF4EC; color: #186130; } .ds-chip--live { background: #B65434; color: #FFFFFF; }

components.name: Card
components.description: The universal reading surface: white ficha on cal with the 1.5px keyline, lifting on hover.
components.html:
Clases recurrentes del mes

Fichas blancas sobre cal, keyline de cancha.
components.css: .ds-card { background: #FFFFFF; color: #241C15; font-family: ui-sans-serif, system-ui, -apple-system, 'Segoe UI', Roboto, 'Helvetica Neue', Arial, sans-serif; border: 1.5px solid #E4DBCB; border-left-width: 1.5px; border-radius: 16px; padding: 20px; box-shadow: 0 1px 2px 0 rgb(0 0 0 / 0.05); transition: box-shadow 150ms; } .ds-card:hover { box-shadow: 0 4px 6px -1px rgb(0 0 0 / 0.1), 0 2px 4px -2px rgb(0 0 0 / 0.1); } .ds-card--cupo { border-left-width: 1px; border-left-color: #B65434; } .ds-card--full { border-left-width: 1px; border-left-color: #C43A2A; } .ds-card-title { font-family: 'Archivo Narrow', 'Arial Narrow', ui-sans-serif, sans-serif; font-weight: 700; font-size: 20px; margin: 0 0 6px; } .ds-card-body { font-size: 16px; line-height: 1.5; margin: 0; color: #241C15; }

components.name: Class Card (day cell)
components.description: A class sitting on the day court: tabular time, cupo keyline, chips — lit when in progress.
components.css: .ds-class-card { display: block; width: 100%; text-align: left; background: #FFFFFF; color: #241C15; font-family: ui-sans-serif, system-ui, -apple-system, 'Segoe UI', Roboto, 'Helvetica Neue', Arial, sans-serif; border: 1.5px solid #E4DBCB; border-left-width: 1px; border-left-color: #B65434; border-radius: 16px; padding: 16px; box-shadow: 0 1px 2px 0 rgb(0 0 0 / 0.05); cursor: pointer; transition: box-shadow 150ms; } .ds-class-card:hover { box-shadow: 0 4px 6px -1px rgb(0 0 0 / 0.1), 0 2px 4px -2px rgb(0 0 0 / 0.1); } .ds-class-card--full { border-left-color: #C43A2A; } .ds-class-card--live { box-shadow: 0 10px 15px -3px rgb(0 0 0 / 0.1), 0 4px 6px -4px rgb(0 0 0 / 0.1); outline: 2px solid #FFFFFF; outline-offset: -2px; } .ds-class-card:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #B65434; outline-offset: 2px; } .ds-class-row { display: flex; justify-content: space-between; align-items: flex-start; gap: 8px; } .ds-class-time { font-family: 'Archivo Narrow', 'Arial Narrow', ui-sans-serif, sans-serif; font-weight: 700; font-size: 16px; font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums; } .ds-class-names { font-size: 14px; margin: 4px 0 8px; }

components.name: Header (placa)
components.description: Sticky full-bleed polvo chrome with the condensed wordmark and the white court line.
components.html:

components.css: .ds-header { display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: space-between; gap: 12px; width: 100%; box-sizing: border-box; background: #B65434; color: #FFFFFF; padding: 12px 16px; border-bottom: 2px solid rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.35); font-family: ui-sans-serif, system-ui, -apple-system, 'Segoe UI', Roboto, 'Helvetica Neue', Arial, sans-serif; } .ds-header-brand { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 8px; color: #FFFFFF; text-decoration: none; } .ds-header-title { font-family: 'Archivo Narrow', 'Arial Narrow', ui-sans-serif, sans-serif; font-weight: 700; font-size: 18px; text-transform: uppercase; letter-spacing: 0.025em; } .ds-header-nav { display: flex; gap: 20px; font-size: 14px; } .ds-header-nav a { color: #FFFFFF; text-decoration: none; transition: text-decoration 150ms; } .ds-header-nav a:hover { text-decoration: underline; text-underline-offset: 4px; } .ds-header-nav a.is-active { font-weight: 600; text-decoration: underline; text-underline-offset: 4px; text-decoration-thickness: 2px; } .ds-header-exit { background: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.15); color: #FFFFFF; border: 1px solid rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.3); border-radius: 8px; padding: 6px 12px; font-size: 14px; cursor: pointer; transition: background 150ms; } .ds-header-exit:hover { background: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.25); }

components.name: Bottom Nav
components.description: Mobile placa fixed to the bottom: 12px labels, active wash, white top court line.
components.css: .ds-bottomnav { position: fixed; left: 0; right: 0; bottom: 0; display: flex; background: #B65434; border-top: 2px solid rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.35); font-family: ui-sans-serif, system-ui, -apple-system, 'Segoe UI', Roboto, 'Helvetica Neue', Arial, sans-serif; } .ds-bottomnav a { flex: 1; padding: 12px 4px; font-size: 12px; text-align: center; color: #FFFFFF; text-decoration: none; transition: background 150ms; } .ds-bottomnav a:hover { background: rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.1); } .ds-bottomnav a.is-active { background: rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.2); font-weight: 600; }

components.css: .ds-day-court { background: #B65434; border-radius: 16px; border-bottom: 2px solid rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.35); padding: 8px 16px; box-shadow: 0 4px 6px -1px rgb(0 0 0 / 0.1), 0 2px 4px -2px rgb(0 0 0 / 0.1); animation: ds-day-in 180ms ease-out both; } @keyframes ds-day-in { from { opacity: 0; transform: translateY(6px); } to { opacity: 1; transform: translateY(0); } } @media (prefers-reduced-motion: reduce) { .ds-day-court { animation: none; } } .ds-hour-row { display: grid; grid-template-columns: 3.5rem 1fr; gap: 12px; border-top: 1px solid rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.4); padding: 12px 0; } .ds-hour-row:first-child { border-top: 0; } .ds-hour { font-family: 'Archivo Narrow', 'Arial Narrow', ui-sans-serif, sans-serif; font-weight: 700; font-size: 14px; font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums; color: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.9); text-align: right; padding-top: 4px; } .ds-hour-lane { display: grid; grid-template-columns: 1fr; gap: 12px; } @media (min-width: 640px) { .ds-hour-lane { grid-template-columns: 1fr 1fr; } }

narrative.overview:
The club's court, rendered as interface: a surface of sun-baked brick dust (#B65434) holding the chrome — header, bottom bar, section plates, the day strip — with white chalk court lines cutting across it, and everything you read sitting on lime wash (#F7F3EA) as clean white fichas (#FFFFFF). It is warm, outdoor, and tactile: the opposite of the gray SaaS dashboard with a sidebar and pastel cards that this world explicitly replaces. The atmosphere is an afternoon at a Río Cuarto club — dust, lime, chalk, felt — not a productivity product.

Density is practical and mobile-first (375px is the main case, sunlight and glare assumed): one screen = one job, big legible figures, chips instead of prose, and the day itself as the primary composition. Type splits into two voices that both echo the club's identity — a condensed grotesque (Archivo Narrow, echoing the "Tenis" wordmark) for anything that names or dates, and a plain system stack for anything you operate. Money and hours are tabular figures, because every number has to show its account.

Depth stays flat and honest: white on lime, a 1.5px warm keyline, and a small ambient shadow that only lifts on state. Exactly one thing on screen is ever lit, and exactly one moment animates.
keyCharacteristics: Full-bleed polvo chrome with white court-line keylines; content always on cal with white fichas.
Feltro yellow (#D9E24F) reserved for the single primary action — its rarity is the point.
Semantic color (red = cupo/extra, green = paid/space) is meaning, never palette.
Condensed display type for headings, wordmark, dates and times; system stack for UI; tabular figures for all numbers.
One motion moment (`day-in`, 180ms) with a reduced-motion guard; everything else transitions only on state.
Spanish copy throughout; ENUM values (`fija`, `extra`, `abierta`, `programada`) stay Spanish.

rules.name: The Feltro Rule
rules.body: Feltro #D9E24F is the only source of yellow and it means one thing: the primary action of the screen (plus the selection highlight). If a second element is feltro, one of them is wrong.

rules.name: The Keyline Rule
rules.body: A colored left keyline is 1px, never thicker, and always carries cupo/modality meaning — red for full or `extra`, polvo for with-space, gray for cancelled. The ficha's own border stays 1.5px of #E4DBCB. Keylines are semantics; they are not decoration.

rules.name: The Polvo Chrome Rule
rules.body: Header, bottom nav, section plates, day strip and day court are full-bleed polvo with white text and a white 35% court line. Cal never bleeds into chrome; polvo never becomes a small card.

rules.name: The Two-Voice Rule
rules.body: Archivo Narrow is for headings, the wordmark, dates and times — nothing else. UI text is the system stack; every figure is tabular. A paragraph set in the display face, or a price set in proportional figures, breaks the world.

rules.name: The Flat-By-Default Rule
rules.body: Surfaces are flat at rest; shadows appear only as a response to state (hover, elevation, the live class). Warm thin scrollbars (#CDC2AE on transparent) keep even the chrome earthy.

dos: Do give each screen exactly one feltro primary action (#D9E24F on #241C15) and let everything else be secondary (white ficha + line border) or a text link.
Do keep the colored left keyline at exactly 1px and semantic: red (#C43A2A) = full/`extra`, polvo (#B65434) = with space, gray = cancelled.
Do render header, bottom nav, section plates, day strip and day court full-bleed polvo with white text and the white/35 court line.
Do set headings, the wordmark, dates and times in Archivo Narrow; all money, hours and counts in tabular-nums.
Do put reading surfaces on cal with white fichas (16px radius, 1.5px #E4DBCB keyline) and shadow only on state.
Do animate only the day change (`day-in`, 180ms ease-out) and respect `prefers-reduced-motion`.
Do keep copy and ENUM values in Spanish (`fija`, `extra`, `abierta`, `programada`, `completada`).
donts: Don't use feltro anywhere except the primary action (and the selection highlight) — not for badges, not for backgrounds, not for secondary buttons.
Don't thicken the semantic keyline past 1px or attach color to a left keyline that carries no cupo/modality meaning.
Don't introduce a second decorative accent: red and green in this system are semantics (cupo, pagado), not palette.
Don't set body or UI text, paragraphs, or tables in the display face; don't render figures without tabular-nums.
Don't add new shadow styles beyond the resting/raised/lit trio, or use hard, offset, or colored shadows.
Don't shrink the mobile gutter below 16px or drop the bottom-nav clearance (`pb-24`) on small screens.
